Resolves #19288

Headless Chrome gives every window an 800×600 screen, and the window manager clamps a script-moved popup into it: a 480 px popup's `moveTo(900, 20)` lands at x = 320. A test that stages a target popup beyond that point (CDP placement is not clamped) leaves the product's own `window.moveTo` unable to follow it, so the park is refused and re-proposed forever. `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS` now carries `--screen-info={1920x1080}`, shared by both launch profiles.

Evidence: L3 (a headless census of the whole NL battery on this head, diffed by title against #17844's 22 at `a9abb6c1dc`) → L3 required for AC-2 and AC-3. Residual: AC-5 (the headed run, on the operator's go)
Residual-Owner: #17844

## AC Evidence
| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | `gpuIntent.mjs`: `BASE_LAUNCH_ARGS` carries the switch. Its JSDoc names the clamp, says why `contextOptions.screen` does not move it, and says that `--window-size` left the screen at 800 px with this configuration's `chrome` channel (the measured rig, not a general Chromium claim). `glState.spec` asserts both profiles carry it |
| AC-2 | Census below: the named rows re-classified. `WorkstationTearOutSourceContinuityNL` › "#16756 no-drag native place-cycle…" is green with the flag and red on dev without it. `DemoBPerspectivesNL` passes the hosting poll and stops at the next assertion ("the original instance mounted once into the popup"), the question this ticket put out of scope. `DockPlacementNL` passes its placement-hint poll and stops later, at `setHistoryDepth(…)` → `false` (line 44). `DemoBCrossWindowDragNL` ×3 stay red with a 1920 px screen: not screen-bound; #17844 already records their branch as unreachable headless |
| AC-3 | The named control holds: `WorkstationNativePopupOverPopupNL` passes all three arms in the head census ("a popup moved by its OS titlebar onto another popup previews there…", "an enlarged popup updates its drop zones…", "resizing an already-hovered popup refreshes its drop zones…"). They are passes, not skips, and they take the rig's wide branch (lines 229–251: `760 + 20 + 200` fits a 1920 px screen, so no shrink). No row that is green on dev turns red. The 10 grid reds fail identically on dev without the flag and at the census head `a9abb6c1dc` in this environment (`connectToApp` times out: the lockedColumns app renders but its worker never registers with this run's bridge). The 2 `WorkstationHumanPopupOverlapNL` large-over-small arms go from skipped to red: the 800 px screen skipped them, and #19297 owns their stale proxy expectation |
| AC-4 | CI `e2e-engine` at this head |
| AC-5 | not run: a headed run places windows on the operator's displays |
